pages.text: The $(item)Chemical Package Filler/$ creates $(l:core/volume_package)Volume Packages/$ filled with chemicals.$(p)This machine requires power.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Chemical Package Filler/$, place next to a chemical container, and place a template chemical container inside.$(p)You can then specify the amount of chemical the created $(l:core/volume_package)Volume Package/$ should contain.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: Finally, apply a redstone signal to the machine to create the package.$(p)The created package will be ejected into adjacent inventories.
